environment: Native C++17 subprocess; stdin/stdout transport; deterministic virtual clock
scope: Educational simulation. No physical hardware or medical-device integration tested.

results.title: Normal communication
results.description: Establish a session, apply a command, and receive telemetry.

results.title: Lost acknowledgement
results.description: A missing reply must not cause duplicate execution.

events.note: The controller executes; the simulated link discards its acknowledgement.
Sender retries the same command ID after receiving no acknowledgement.

results.title: Delayed command after reconnect
results.description: Reject commands belonging to an earlier session.

events.note: Reconnect with a new session; device output is retained.
A delayed command from the previous connection arrives.

results.title: Out-of-order commands
results.description: An older command must not overwrite a newer one.

events.note: An earlier command arrives after a newer command.

results.title: Command ID conflict
results.description: Reject a changed payload reusing the latest command ID.

events.note: The same ID must never identify two different payloads.

results.title: Telemetry freshness boundary
results.description: Mark readings stale at exactly 1,000 ms without a new sample.

events.note: Advance virtual time, without delivering telemetry.
The 1,000 ms limit is an educational requirement.

results.title: Telemetry recovery and reordering
results.description: Recover on fresh telemetry without accepting delayed old samples.

events.note: A newer sample restores freshness.
Delayed telemetry cannot replace the latest sample.
Rejected telemetry must not refresh the freshness timer.

results.title: Lost command
results.description: Dropping a request leaves the device unchanged; a retry can succeed.

events.note: This frame never reaches the C++ subprocess.
The sender retries after loss.

results.title: Repeated handshake
results.description: A handshake retry must not erase duplicate-command protection.

events.note: A retried handshake must preserve command history.

results.title: Malformed and invalid input
results.description: Reject malformed frames and out-of-range values without mutations.

results.title: Oversized input recovery
results.description: Reject a long frame and correctly parse the next frame.

events.note: Consume an oversized frame without losing the next frame boundary.

results.title: Session establishment
results.description: Require a session and reject zero or decreasing session epochs.

results.title: Old-session telemetry
results.description: A new connection starts with unknown monitoring state.

events.note: Telemetry from an earlier connection must not appear current.

results.title: Monotonic test clock
results.description: The deterministic fixture refuses backward time.

results.title: Link silence and reconnection
results.description: A link interruption alone never changes the indicator setting.

events.note: Simulated link silence changes freshness, not the virtual indicator output.

results.title: Value and sequence boundaries
results.description: Exercise 0, 100 and the maximum 64-bit command ID.

events.note: Sequence numbers never wrap silently.

results.title: Serial line formatting
results.description: Accept tabs, spacing, and CRLF-compatible frames.

results.title: Invalid and duplicate telemetry
results.description: Invalid or duplicate samples cannot make data fresh.

events.note: A duplicate sample cannot extend freshness.
